First has a filled tinted background, clear title/body separation, and actionable buttons (Update payment method / Dismiss), giving stronger hierarchy and clarity; second is a bare bordered box with no actions and passes design_slop only by being minimal, not by being better composed.

First has generous balanced padding, a clean divider separating description from body, and a colored badge plus colored icon-link that read as distinct affordances; second is cramped against the card edges with an oddly rendered border and a flat gray badge that barely stands out.
